_comment: Canonical Romanised-Hindi spelling -> list of variant spellings that map to it. Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive (see src/preprocess.py). Rules for adding entries: (1) only add a variant if it is NOT a common English word (so no 'he', 'me', 'per', 'par', 'hay', 'kia'); (2) a variant may appear under one canonical form only; (3) a canonical form must not also be listed as a variant; (4) derive entries from TRAIN tweets or general knowledge, never from dev/test data or labels. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
